Citymaker.Recipe.SplitParkPlaza.Descript: Divides the area: a park on one side, a plaza on the other. Drag the divider or the slider.
Citymaker.Split.Name: Split
Citymaker.Split.cuts.Tooltip: Click two points on the outline to draw a dividing line (two more for a second line). Without a divider, the sliders decide.
Citymaker.Split.ratio.Tooltip: Share of the area that goes to the first part.
Citymaker.Split.angle.Tooltip: 0° cuts across the long side; 90° cuts lengthwise.
Citymaker.Split.divider.Tooltip: Adds a footpath along each dividing line.
Citymaker.Split.Issue.CannotSplit: The area could not be divided this way, so it was kept whole.
Citymaker.Split.Issue.UnpairedMarker: A divider needs two points on the outline; the last point is ignored.
